blocks.text: Padding is space inside a box. Margin is space outside a box. Tailwind uses short names for both.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.
Read the code step by step

items: `p-4` adds inner space using Tailwind's spacing scale. It is a scale step rather than four pixels.

blocks.text: The box has inner padding, a border and extra space below its outside edge.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The number in p-4 is a step on the spacing scale, not four pixels.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change p-4 to p-8 and compare the inner space.
